title: Digital Arrest CBI Notice (English)
text: URGENT NOTICE FROM CENTRAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION (CBI) & MUMBAI POLICE CYBER CELL. A courier parcel containing 5 fake passports and 150g narcotics was intercepted at Mumbai Airport registered under your Aadhaar. You are placed under 24-HOUR DIGITAL ARREST. Do not leave your house or disconnect this video call. Report on Skype immediately to Officer Sharma or non-bailable arrest warrant will be issued within 1 hour.
